user.title: Connect Contarina SOL
user.description: Login always happens on the official Contarina website: Home Assistant never sees or stores your password.

menu_options.setup_browser: Connect from the browser (recommended, works from a phone)

contracts.title: Select contracts
contracts.description: Choose which contracts Home Assistant should monitor.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Contarina SOL
reauth_confirm.description: Choose how to provide a new SOL session. Login always happens on the official website; Home Assistant never sees your password.

reconnect_paste.title: Paste the SOL token
reconnect_paste.description: Sign in to SOL, copy the token with the «Copia token Contarina» bookmark and paste it here within a few minutes.

reconnect_browser.title: Reconnect from the browser
reconnect_browser.description:
Click **Open website**, sign in to Contarina SOL and use the «Invia token a Home Assistant» bookmark. This window updates automatically.

If you sign in to SOL from another browser or your phone, enter this pairing code: **{code}** (valid 10 minutes, single use).

setup_browser.title: Connect from the browser
setup_browser.description:
Click **Open website**, sign in to Contarina SOL and use the «Invia token a Home Assistant» bookmark. This window updates automatically.

If you sign in to SOL from another browser or your phone, enter this pairing code: **{code}** (valid 10 minutes, single use).

setup_paste.title: Paste the SOL token
setup_paste.description: Sign in to the Contarina portal, copy the token with the «Copia token Contarina» bookmark and paste it here within a few minutes. Do not enter your portal password.

error.invalid_contracts: Select at least one valid contract
error.wrong_account: This token belongs to another SOL account
error.no_url: Home Assistant URL could not be determined: paste the token or set the URL in Settings → System → Network
error.already_configured: This SOL account is already configured

abort.reauth_wrong_account: This token belongs to another account

data.notify_service: Push notification when the session expires (optional)
